summary: Comprehensive testing of Laravel 10 Club Privileges Dashboard. All 11 requested features tested and verified: Login flow, Light Mode default, Theme toggle, Theme persistence, Ooredoo billing rate (12.71%), Eklektik daily stats table, Eklektik Export/Copier buttons, Profile dropdown, Dashboard KPIs, Charts in Light mode, Subscription details modal (no pattern error).
passed_tests: Login flow works with superadmin@ooredoo.tn / SuperAdmin@2025
Light Mode is DEFAULT theme when loading dashboard (no dark-mode class on html)
Theme toggle button (#theme-toggle-btn) in header switches between Light and Dark mode
Theme preference persists via localStorage ('dashboard-theme') after page reload
Ooredoo/DGV tab 'Taux de Facturation' KPI shows 12.71% (average of daily rates)
Ooredoo/DGV tab shows 8 KPI cards as expected
Eklektik tab shows 'Statistiques Quotidiennes Eklektik' table with data-testid='eklektik-daily-stats-table'
Eklektik daily stats table has expandable monthly rows showing daily details
Export CSV button on Eklektik table found and working
Copier button on Eklektik table found and working
Profile dropdown menu (#profileDropdown) opens/closes correctly and shows menu items
Dashboard KPIs load and display correctly in both Light and Dark mode
Charts render with appropriate colors in Light mode (purple/gold theme)
Subscription details modal works without 'The string did not match the expected pattern' error
SubStore dashboard has matching theme variables (Light/Dark mode support)
critical_code_review_comments: All requested features are working correctly
Light Mode is properly set as default in :root CSS variables
Dark Mode is properly defined in .dark-mode class
Theme toggle button correctly toggles dark-mode class on documentElement
localStorage is used to persist theme preference
Ooredoo billing rate uses average of daily rates (total_taux_facturation) from backend
Eklektik daily stats table properly implemented with expandable rows
Subscription modal validates clientId before API call (fixes pattern error)
Profile dropdown properly positioned and styled
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 requested features have been verified and are working correctly. The dashboard is fully functional with: Light Mode as default, working theme toggle with persistence, correct Ooredoo billing rate calculation, Eklektik daily stats table with expandable rows, working profile dropdown, and fixed subscription details modal.
